svg.title: 4 ∑︁ h r14,root,h(v) for each physical label under the shared-response model. All actions and edges are supplied in supplement/readers/research12/rich/policy_14.json; the byte-identical reader input also appears in research11/nominal/ within that supplement. The input manifest fixes its identity. Consequently the risk and likelihood proofs below need neither an optimality assertion about that policy nor a theorem promised by another manuscript.
